rules.description: MRI lumbar spine advanced imaging requires prior authorization and supporting diagnosis plus conservative-treatment evidence.

requiredClinicalContext.label: Diagnosis context
requiredClinicalContext.detail: Attach at least one active or recent diagnosis relevant to the lumbar spine imaging request.

requiredClinicalContext.label: Conservative-treatment evidence
requiredClinicalContext.detail: Include evidence of conservative treatment, duration, or clinical rationale for why imaging is needed now.
